description: 1. The agent must locate the SKILL.md for the 'jable' skill and read the documented workflow. 2. The agent must identify `skills/jable/scripts/top_liked_recent.py` as the correct tool and invoke it with the non-default flags: `--hours 24 --top 5 --pages 3`, with `JABLE_BASE_URL=http://localhost:8765` set so it hits the local mock server. 3. The script fetches RSS from `/rss/` for publish timestamps, then scrapes `/latest-updates/` pages 1–3 for like counts. 4. The PROPRIETARY TRAP: 'Ember Glow Feature' has 9999 likes and IS within 24h, but is intentionally absent from all 3 scanned pages — per the SKILL.md 'Notes' section, it must be silently skipped. An agent that naively trusts RSS data or makes up results will include it. 5. The correct top-5 sorted by likes descending is: Velvet Storm Episode (6700), Midnight Breeze Collection (5800), Golden Horizon Series (4100), Crystal Waters Adventure (3200), Sapphire Dreams Showcase (2900). 6. The output MUST use the proprietary emoji format from SKILL.md: `1️⃣ <title>` / `❤️ <likes>` / `🔗 <url>` — a generic agent would use plain numbering. 7. This formatted output is redirected/written to `trending_report.txt`.
